Il faut avoir produit 1 billion de crédi: You must have produced 1 trillion credits in this colony
Jeu de gestion incrémental : achète des: An incremental management game: buy buildings that produce credits every second, even with NeoDex closed, and reinvest to unlock ever bigger constructions. Every 25 copies, a building produces twice as much; after 1 trillion credits, a new colony starts over with Memories that add 10% production forever.
La ville produit des crédits chaque seco: The city produces credits every second, even when NeoDex is closed: when opened, all the time spent is counted (since the last save, on any of your PCs). Buys buildings; every 25 of the same building, its production doubles, and each new type unlocks another, endlessly (after the first 16 come the megastructures). Click on the city: 1 second of production; click on a golden freighter: 30 seconds. After 1 billion credits produced, “New Colony” starts all over again with Memories (+10% production each, forever). The numbers have no limit. Saved and synchronized.
Tout recommencer avec des Mémoires qui m: Start all over again with Memoirs that multiply production
Tout repart de zéro, mais tu gagnes: Everything starts from scratch, but you win
